title: SMU hosts California at Gerald J. Ford Stadium in Saturday conference game
text:
SMU hosts California at Gerald J. Ford Stadium in Saturday conference game
SMU, 5-1 and third in the Atlantic Coast Conference, hosts 3-4 California at 11 a.m. Saturday, Oct. 24, at Gerald J. Ford Stadium. The game airs on The CW, and the Mustangs travel to Syracuse the following week.
SMU will host California at 11 a.m. on Saturday, Oct. 24, at Gerald J. Ford Stadium in an Atlantic Coast Conference game televised on The CW, ESPN reported on its SMU schedule.
The Mustangs enter the game 5-1 and third in the conference standings. SMU opened the season with a 27-24 win at Florida State on Sept. 7, beat UC Davis 56-10 at home on Sept. 12 and lost 41-31 at Louisville on Sept. 19. The team then won three straight home games, beating Missouri State 34-24 on Sept. 26, Boston College 25-16 on Oct. 3 and Virginia 23-13 on Oct. 17. After Saturday's game, SMU plays at Syracuse on Oct. 31.
California is 3-4 and eighth in the conference standings, according to ESPN's California schedule. The Golden Bears opened with a 45-24 home loss to UCLA, then won 21-18 at Syracuse and beat Wagner 49-7. California lost 24-10 to Clemson and 39-31 at UNLV before beating Virginia Tech 25-20 at home on Oct. 10. In its most recent game, California lost 41-7 to Wake Forest on Oct. 17.
Gerald J. Ford Stadium is at 5801 Bush Ave. in Dallas, according to Visit Dallas, which lists the SMU-California game on its events calendar.
Saturday's game is one of three home games for Dallas' major professional and college teams this weekend. The Mavericks host the San Antonio Spurs on Saturday night at American Airlines Center, and the Stars host the New York Islanders there on Sunday, according to the National Hockey League.
